events.observed_signal: Broad and exact-caption public searches returned shop, channel or unrelated pages rather than attributable canonical TikTok video URLs.

correction.action: Narrowed discovery to newly evidenced official channel and Creative Center frontiers without replaying P54 provider surfaces.

events.schema_impact: None; only sanitized source evidence was extended.
events.quality_impact: Prevents search snippets without stable identity from being retained as source records.

learning.reusable_lesson: TikTok search-index results can identify useful official frontiers while still failing the stable-video identity contract.
learning.future_prevention: Require stable video ID plus official canonical resolution before any TikTok candidate is retained.

events.observed_signal: Official TikTok oEmbed resolved a Creative Center stable ID to creator, title and canonical video identity, but its diving keyword described generated animal-sports content rather than a diving lesson or equipment.

correction.action: Recorded oEmbed as a viable official per-URL verifier while rejecting the irrelevant candidate and leaving the technique unfrozen.

events.schema_impact: None; no raw oEmbed payload was persisted.
events.quality_impact: Proves the verification mechanism without treating keyword collision as source quality.

learning.reusable_lesson: A valid official identity is necessary but not sufficient for topic-qualified retention.
learning.future_prevention: Apply topic qualification after official identity resolution and before fixture creation.

events.observed_signal: Search-indexed Creative Center evidence exposed stable IDs, but direct public hashtag pages redirected or returned a public shell with no stable identity state.

correction.action: Separated cached search-index evidence from live official-page behavior and retained neither as a canonical source record.

events.schema_impact: None; public shells were summarized and discarded.
events.quality_impact: Avoids converting cached identity lists or application shells into reproducible live acquisition evidence.

learning.reusable_lesson: Search-index visibility of Creative Center IDs does not guarantee the same records are available from the current live public page.
learning.future_prevention: Require current live reproduction before claiming a multi-record technique.

events.observed_signal: Fifteen predeclared candidate oEmbed attempts and one direct Creative Center attempt failed at network preconnect without reaching TikTok.

correction.action: Counted all sixteen attempts against the outbound ceiling, made no identical sandbox replay, and used one approved-network public-page test to distinguish environment failure from provider behavior.

events.schema_impact: None; transport failures are represented only as sanitized classifications.
events.quality_impact: Conservative accounting prevents environment failures from silently expanding the authorized request budget.

learning.reusable_lesson: Preconnect failures still consume a bounded experiment's outbound-attempt budget when the contract is stated in outbound requests rather than provider completions.
learning.future_prevention: Preflight the approved network path with one request before scheduling a bounded candidate batch.

events.observed_signal: After 27 of 40 new outbound attempts, no retained scuba record exists and two official verification rounds for ten final records require at least twenty more requests before additional discovery.

correction.action: Stopped live retrieval at the hard request boundary and prohibited adapter, fixture, Registry V3, MTC, PR or merge claims.

events.schema_impact: No V3 registry, source manifest, run manifest or fixture was created.
events.quality_impact: Prevents a false-green MTC or technique freeze when the required repeated official verification cannot be completed inside authority.

learning.reusable_lesson: A reproducible single-record resolver does not establish discovery, topic coverage or a two-round Minimum Trusted Connection.
learning.future_prevention: Obtain a reviewed request-budget extension or a genuine official multi-record discovery surface before resuming; do not replay P57 automatically.

events.observed_signal: Pre-submission inspection found the initial journal closure time had been rounded forward beyond the current repository observation clock.

correction.action: Replaced the rounded future timestamps with bounded observed times and added this durable correction before Result submission.

events.schema_impact: None; the correction changes provenance timestamps and journal accounting only.
events.quality_impact: Prevents future-dated closure evidence from entering the coordination Result.

learning.reusable_lesson: Evidence timestamps must be captured from the observation clock rather than rounded to a future convenience value.
learning.future_prevention: Read the current clock immediately before finalizing journal timestamps and validate closure time before committing.
